prompts.name: Morrow Repairs
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape architectural hero production concept sheet for BeatMakka / Needle Quay, matching the supplied previous hero sheet's visual language and editorial layout. Input image 1 is the approved STYLE AUTHORITY board, not a layout to copy. Input image 2 is the Lantern Room sheet for sheet design consistency, not the building subject. Warm off-white paper, dark elegant serif headline, sparse legible English annotations, thin blue dimension arrows. Large colored isometric three-quarter building view on left; consistent FRONT VIEW, SIDE VIEW, TOP VIEW roof and diagrammatic access/floor plan at right; SAME GEOMETRY BEFORE / AFTER paired small views at bottom, plus material swatches. Chunky softly beveled forms, slightly asymmetric port architecture, worn but maintained, faded teal, cream trims, walnut, dusty coral, oxidized brass, warm amber. Broad stylized surfaces and restrained wear matching the board, no photorealistic grime, no destruction, no neon/cyberpunk, no real brands or copyrighted graphics. Views must depict one coherent building. Show useful uncluttered production information, not rows of decorative tiny text. Dimension order W x D x H in STUDS, arrows placed on corresponding axes; quayside presentation base not included in the building envelope. No invented measurements beyond given envelope. Front is -Z in plan. NPCs are named placement DOTS ONLY, not new character designs. No game commands in textures. Footer exactly 'CONCEPT CANDIDATE / ART REVIEW PENDING'. Illustrated views are concepts, not precision engineering drawings. Title 'MORROW REPAIRS', ID 'NQ-BLD-03'. Envelope WIDTH 32, DEPTH 24, total HEIGHT 19 studs. Low broad mechanic's workshop, large sliding door on exposed rail, front work zone with tool rack and bench, large metal ventilation grille, rhythm suggested by repeated vertical broad vent ribs and repeated mechanical forms. Visually distinctive repair shop, not record shop or club; no vinyl record sign. One visible fan/vent mechanism, isolated mechanical detail inset showing the proposed vent interaction target 'I02 / vent_thump' and separate fan/grille parts as concept. Front zone accessible, back rooms closed decorative. Plan labels 'FRONT WORK ZONE', 'VENT', 'CLOSED SERVICE', 'IVO' dot; show entrance route kept clear and door sliding direction with arrow, no tiny clutter. NQ-SGN-03 signage integrated. Before: fan idle, amber fault lamp, quiet workbench. After: same fan geometry in operating pose, warm working lights, orderly active work area; do not replace building or enlarge it. Labels 'Q04 / VENT REPAIR' and 'Q05 / A/B VARIATION' in sheet annotations only. Materials 'MAT-01 TEAL METAL', 'MAT-02 CREAM TRIM', 'MAT-03 WALNUT', 'MAT-08 CAST IRON', 'MAT-09 BRASS'. Include small reuse inset for vent grille, sliding door, wall panel, not exploded full building.

corrections.prompt: Targeted architectural consistency correction. Edit ONLY the small panel labeled TOP VIEW (ROOF), located near the middle-right of this Harbor Market Hall sheet, immediately left of TOP VIEW (FLOOR PLAN). Replace the incorrect fully solid teal roof in that small roof panel with a coherent top-down roof view of the SAME semi-open market shown in the large isometric: chunky teal rectangular perimeter frame, open central aisle/court visible from above, EXACTLY FOUR separate coral-and-cream canvas stall canopies around the aisle (two per side), a low solid rear/right technical service roof, no solid roof over the central public aisle. Keep the rear performance nook and four-stall organization consistent with the existing floor plan. It is a semi-open covered market, not a fully enclosed solid-roof warehouse. Preserve the panel footprint, label, paper background, all other image content, dimensions 48 x 30 x 16, main isometric, before/after views, front/side views, all text and swatches. Do not modify any other panel. Do not add new stalls, stories, labels, or dimensions.
